scope: Actual public pixiv.New, Artwork, ArtworkPages and OpenResource using the SDK-owned clone of official Go net/http Transport on Linux/amd64, with local synthetic TLS HTTP/1.1 peers

protected_inventory.comparison: Full byte equality against git show at frozen_go, for every non-test .go file and go.mod/go.sum

official_source_observations.behavior: CloseIdleConnections removes current idle entries and sets closeIdle=true; active connections are not interrupted
A returning HTTP/1 connection is rejected while closeIdle remains true
A later request pool acquisition clears closeIdle
Body-return/drain and request cancellation are competing readLoop selections. Private idle-return callback snapshots on canceled response bodies are not deterministic

Go 1.27.1 may drain an early-closed small response body for up to 50 milliseconds. The early-close case deliberately withholds the remaining body, verifies actual peer closure, and claims no ready-body early-close result

raw_observation_policy.normalization: None. All SDK errors, body-read errors, wire hosts/targets/methods/protocols, connection IDs, closure checkpoints and explicitly awaited idle-return events compare exactly
raw_observation_policy.not_contractual: Private idle-return observer snapshots without an explicit idle-return barrier are retained in raw-private-idle-traces.json and raw-private-idle-variation.json, not treated as proof of callback absence

boundary_limits: No HTTP/2, multiplexed streams, unfinished HEAD, upload, redirect, proxy, native Windows/Darwin, or real Pixiv/account/media behavior is established by these rows

Fixed logical app-api.pixiv.net and i.pximg.net URLs are mapped by a strict owned DialContext to an owned local listener. Proxy and HTTP/2 are disabled in the test-only default-transport template. No DNS, external network, credentials, host trust-store changes or InsecureSkipVerify are used

The synthetic TLS certificate is trusted only by the temporary test transport, with its synthetic DNS identity explicitly verified. The public SDK clones that template; Options.HTTPClient is not injected and no private Client ownership fields or resource caches are changed
Resource identity/locator preload uses the actual public ArtworkPages operation and its returned ResourceRef. Bodies are synthetic JSON and three literal bytes, not actual media

All barriers and SDK contexts are bounded by ten seconds. Cleanup cancels owned calls, releases response gates, joins SDK request workers and local peer handlers, closes sockets, and restores DefaultTransport; no t.Parallel or fixed sleeps are used
Peer closure is observed independently through server ConnState(StateClosed). Request and body completion, sender drop, and empty pool state are not used as substitutes for actual peer shutdown

Repeated close is exercised while active and in the mixed idle/active schedule. Default constructor validation, failed Open pool retention, caller-owned no-op and independent owned pools are handled by the separate client-ownership contract
No Cargo commands, Rust edits, Go production edits, go.mod/go.sum edits or previously denied supplemental probes are performed
